newsitem.title: UK: London Freight sees Atlantic Panamax demand.
newsitem.headline: London Freight sees Atlantic Panamax demand.

text.p: Demand for modern Panamaxes in the north and south Atlantic continued to be the most positive feature of the freight market for owners. As a result the BFI rose 8 points to 1282. Grain houses were the most active charterers. Caper business was sluggish worldwide, and Handy-size rates continued to be generally depressed.

Cargill and Continental both resorted to timecharter for their US Gulf/Japan business. Cargill were reported to have taken the Shinwa vessel Peoria 70,236 dwt delivery US Gulf end June at $12,500 daily plus $250,000 bonus, and Continental booked the 1981-built Petriana 64,911 dwt on subjects with early July delivery at $11,250 daily plus $200,000 bonus. Brokers said that for a relatively old, deep and thirsty vessel Petriana received a generous rate. There was talk of Egyptian requirements of upto 10 Panamaxes from US Gulf for 1/20 July. Two of these were repoed covered - the 1995-built Maritsa 73,246 dwt to misr at $10,100 daily plus $150,000 bonus redelivery Passero, and the 1980-built Marigo P 60,190 dwt to NNC at $8,500 daily plus $190,000 bonus redelivery Egyptian Med.

Tradigrain were now said to be willing to fix on timecharter for their stem to Egypt. There was little reported in the way of concluded Panamax business from S America, but from N France Dreyfus were said to have booked the 1996-built Umberto D'Amato 74,500 dwt for prompt dely trip Aqaba at $11,500 daily. Some brokers found this level unlikely in view of the fact that charterers were believed to have bid over-age tonnage in the region of $11,000/11,250 daily. There was some Handy activity from S America. Toepfer covered about 20,000 heavy grain up River and Buenos Aires to W Coast UK at close to an economical $22.00 basis 2-1, Galaxy were on subjects for about 25/30,000 tonnes Plate/Libya for June loading, and E D and F Man fixed a 37,000 dwt bulker delivery Azil trip Med at close to $8,500 daily. New business was quoted by Glencore of 25,000 barley St Lawrence/Limassol prompt, Soufflet 25,000 wheat N France/Cuba 19/24 June, and Dreyfus 8/12,000 products 60' Denmark/ Mississippi 25 June/10 July.

SGC Capitol was said to have failed on subjects with Yukong for 160,000 Coal Richards Bay/Rotterdam for July/Aug at about $6.00. Coe and Clerici were said to have fixed 100,000/10 coal Norfolk/el Dekheila for 15/30 July, but otherwise Caper markets were flat. In the Panamax category Duferco booked Angelic Grace for 65,000/10 coal Mobile/Constanza for prompt loading at $9.25, and Sun P 65,000 dwt open prompt Lisbon was believed fixed for short period business, not necessarily in minerals. Cobelfret fixed 50,000 ironore PDM/Japan on private terms. Brokers were divided about market conditions in the east, some believing that owners could expect improvement, others that Japanese coal chartering activity had peaked. Bocimar wer linked with Galene 73,670 dwt for coal from Indonesia to Japan, and there were reports of Red Cherry 63,000 dwt fixed from Hongkong by HMM for a Dalrymple coal round voyage at $9,000 daily.
